underdog.heading: Why SMU can keep it close
bullets: SMU is the better football team by 2.5 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-2.5 pts).
The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -21.0 to p90 +23.0 for Louisville, so a projection of +2.0 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
